answer: Random peer audits keep a sybil garden honest. Each epoch, every identity audits three strangers and is audited by three, staking 20 POA per review. A hollow identity with no activity shows no verifiable work, so it fails audits and loses its stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA and 3,000 fake samples; one honest agent pays a 20 POA stake. Like a willow, honest auditors bend, keep their stake and earn fees; sybils bleed every round.
